opening.argument: The video presents a Telugu walkthrough of creating a YouTube channel and making money from it. The visible steps show channel setup, video upload settings, and monetization eligibility; the AdSense pages appear in that same instructional sequence. The demat-account links and AdSense verification action warrant attention, but the available evidence does not show the creator directing viewers to provide credentials, pay money, or accept a deceptive offer. On this record, those pages do not turn the walkthrough into a solicitation.
